title: 21 in. Super Recycler 60-Volt SmartStow Max Cordless Battery Walk Behind Mower 7.5 Ah Battery and Charger Included
description:
Description
The Toro Super Recycler is a commercial-grade 21-inch cordless walk-behind mower engineered to deliver a precise cut while nourishing your lawn through advanced mulching technology. Dual blade accelerators combined with under-deck wedges shave clippings into an ultra-fine mulch, returning nutrients back into the lawn with every pass.
Powered by Toro’s 60V Flex-Force battery system with a Brushless DC Motor, this mower tackles up to 50 minutes of continuous mowing on a single charge and is compatible with Toro’s full lineup of 35+ 60V Flex-Force tools. Vortex air intake technology increases airflow into the cutting chamber for finer mulching, while the commercial-grade Bagging Tunnel directs clippings further into the bag, reducing how often you need to empty it.
Personal Pace Auto-Drive self-propel technology automatically adjusts to match your walking speed across hills and varied terrain, while Flex Handle Suspension reduces hand and wrist fatigue during use. The mower offers 3-in-1 versatility with mulching, bagging, and side discharge options, plus 9 cutting positions ranging from 1 to 4 inches and two adjustable handle heights.
Built for durability with a commercial-grade cast aluminum deck and ball bearing wheels, the Super Recycler folds and locks for SmartStow vertical storage, saving up to 70% more space in your garage or shed.
Key Specs:
Cutting Width: 21 in
Battery: 60V Flex-Force, 7.5 Ah (included)
Charger: Included
Motor: Brushless DC
Run Time: Up to 50 minutes per charge
Cutting Height Range: 1″–4″ (9 positions)
Deck Material: Cast Aluminum
Wheels: Ball Bearing
Cutting Modes: Mulching, Bagging, Side Discharge
Storage: SmartStow (fold, lock, vertical storage)
Warranty: 5-Year Limited Mower Warranty, 3-Year Battery Warranty
